comment: THE SKIP CENSUS for the CI `tests` job (inert-test audit finding #3, 2026-08-04).
A green run cannot tell 'deliberately dev-box-only' from 'dark by accident' -- this file can.
tools/gf_test.py --skip-census asserts the observed skip inventory against these families:
every observed skip reason must regex-match exactly one family, and every family's count is
EXACT. A new skip family, a vanished one, or a count change all fail the job, so waking or
darkening a test is always a reviewed diff to this file, never an accident.
Counts were MEASURED in the CI-equivalent layout (upstream AP inside the repo checkout,
bundle ensured, client at the gitlink) on 2026-08-04 post-#244: 1555 passed, 77 skipped.
(The 2026-08-04 #244 fix woke grace_skip_oracle: its known-red family, 5 skips, is GONE --
the oracle now runs green in this job, plus two artifact-free Regression244 pins.)
The bucket story per suite lives in tools/gf_suite_ledger.py; this file pins the numbers.
If you make a skip go away on purpose: celebrate, then lower the count here in the same PR.

families.why: self-expiring freeze: 33 suite tests + 1 tripwire, all skipped while boss_keys is off the yaml surface (test_gf_boss_keys.py). Re-exposing the option wakes the suite and reds the tripwire, and this count going to 0 reds the census too.

self-expiring freeze, now HALF expired. progressive_stone_bells was UNFROZEN 2026-08-10 (issue #506) and its 16 cases WOKE -- the wake is the good news the old note asked us to celebrate. progressive_stonesword_keys is still frozen and keeps its own class skip and its own tripwire, so this family is now keys-only: 5 skips, no tripwire (the keys tripwire RUNS and passes while they are frozen). Counted off the CI run that woke them, not derived -- WorldTestBase generates inherited cases per subclass, so the number cannot be worked out from the source.
test_gf_grace_region_correctness.py needs grace_region_map_*.tsv + grace_flags.tsv, Windows-side dumps NOT in the gen_inputs bundle. Dev-box coverage (run_ci.ps1).
test_gf_grace_region_correctness.py's tracked no-independent-oracle stub -- a documented gap, kept visible on purpose.

test_gf_grace_skip_classes.py gates all 12 tests on grace_flags.tsv (Windows dump, not bundled) even though event/ + BonfireWarpParam.csv are; splitting the suite is noted follow-up in tools/gf_suite_ledger.py.
test_gf_region_artifact_oracle.py needs REGION_ID_MAP.md + the grace dump TSVs; neither ships in the bundle. Dev-box coverage (run_ci.ps1).
test_gf_filler_economy_floor.py: the shipped playtest recipe reserves no somber_stones, so the reservation assertion has nothing to hold -- content-dependent, not layout-dependent.

test_gf_contract_versions.py derives the ledger history from `git tag` (2026-08-14, replacing a typed SHIPPED fixture). This job's checkout is SHALLOW -- fetch-tags is set on `generators` only, which is where these four actually run. They loud-skip here rather than iterating an empty derivation, which would pass vacuously and is the exact failure the derivation was meant to end. If this count reaches 0, either the tests job started fetching tags (good -- lower it deliberately) or the guard was deleted and the ratchet is now green over nothing.

test_gf_sweep_anchor_coords is a GENERATORS suite (ledgered there) and gates tools/derive_sweep_anchor_coords.py, which the installed world does not carry -- so all 5 cases skip in THIS job and run in the generators job instead. The count is 5 and must move with the suite: a case added or retired there is a reviewed diff here.
